A room made of light.

TWO IMPLEMENTATION PLANS

A / ENCLOSURE

Four surfaces.

One shared volume.

Four gauze curtains define a three-dimensional stage.

Projections occupy the surfaces while performers

remain visible inside.

B / ADAPTATION

A space shaped

by its venue.

The same medium can be reconfigured in response to

a local setting. Screen placement, visual sequence and

audience viewpoint form a site-specific narrative.

Original concept imagery / relationship study.

Not a measured construction drawing.

01 / PROJECTED IMAGE

Light gives the surface its

presence.

02 / LIVE PERFORMER

The body remains visible

through the image.

03 / TRANSLUCENT GAUZE

A membrane between image

and room.

CONCEPT → PERFORMANCE / FIRST INDOOR SERIES

ECHO SPACE / A PERFORMANCE ALBUM
